name: io.github.Avada-AI/shopify-chatgpt-ads
description: Manage ChatGPT (OpenAI) ads for a Shopify store: campaigns start paused, spending needs an explicit yes.

environmentVariables.name: OPENAI_ADS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: OpenAI Advertiser API key (Ads Manager > Settings > API keys)

environmentVariables.name: AVADA_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional avk_live_ key from Avada ChatGPT Ads for measured orders and True ROAS

environmentVariables.name: CHATGPT_ADS_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to offer no write tool
